facts: The archived NIOSH table places the following materials in the 8-hour (8 hr) barrier group for hydrogen chloride: Butyl; Teflon; Saranex; Barricade; Responder; Trellchem; Tychem.
The archived NIOSH table places the following materials in the 4-hour (4 hr) barrier group for hydrogen chloride: Neoprene; PVC.
The archived NIOSH table includes the hazard language for hydrogen chloride: “Prevent skin contact (solution) / Frostbite” and the note “Prevent possible skin freezing from direct liquid contact.”
